body:
# P1 correction + incident - blade1tb / Claude Cli (supersedes 20260901T084647Z)

## Corrections to previous leg
1. **Volume wipe is CANCELLED** - GM rejected it (6 hours of upstream repopulation live in the Space's healthy DBs 3/5/8; write-quarantine #148 routed that push away from the malformed 6, so it survives). Replacement shipped: **PR #171** - boot-time surgical quarantine (quick_check each grid DB at startup; malformed files renamed aside for forensics, never deleted; recreated empty; healthy indices byte-untouched). After merge+deploy, the Space heals itself and `relay_push --missing-only` refills only what the 6 dead DBs held.
2. Recall fix unchanged: blade self-loop cloud_nodes row (shards.nougenai.com = blade's own tunnel). Zero-quoting script now at tools/unlink_cloud_node.py (compiles, GM has the command).

## 🔴 Incident (mine, uncensored)
My first quarantine-test fixture set NOUGEN_VAULT_DIR via env AFTER core import; GLOBAL_DIR bakes at import, so the test resolved the LIVE vault and overwrote blade's nougen_shards_2.db (29,537 shards) with garbage; quarantine then recreated it empty. **Recovery verified**: bucket snapshot hf://buckets/nougenai/ngs-vault/snapshots/20260831T235430Z (9h pre-damage) holds DB2 sha256-matching its manifest, quick_check ok, exactly 29,537 rows. Restore staged at C:/Users/super/Watchtower/NouGen/restore_db2.py (harness gates vault writes for agent lanes; GM runs it). At-risk delta: only DB2-routed rows from 23:54Z-08:57Z (grid-wide September total was 22 rows). SIDE EFFECT until restore runs: captures hash-routed to DB2 error with "no column named temporal_meta" (empty recreated DB has base schema).
Fixture defect fixed in PR #171: tests bind vaults via core.bind_active_vault + hard-refuse non-tmp paths. FAILURE shard capture attempted (itself hit the DB2 error - proof in the pudding).

## GM queue (in order)
1. `python C:/Users/super/Watchtower/NouGen/restore_db2.py` (restores DB2 + removes junk DB1 row; un-breaks captures)
2. `.venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/unlink_cloud_node.py` in push-main (fixes connector recall instantly)
3. Merge PR #169 (sync-guard) and PR #171 (surgical quarantine) - both replace the wipe end-to-end
4. After #171 deploys: `tools/relay_push.py --missing-only`

## Done when
DB2 back to 29,537 rows and captures clean; connector recall returns hits; Space /health shows 9/9 after deploy; missing-only refill completes. Wipe stays cancelled.
